note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(运动/竞赛主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: When Daniel joined the school running team, he came last in almost every race and often thought about quitting. Instead of giving up, he trained a little harder each week and learned from the runners who beat him. By the end of the year, he had cut his time by half a minute and felt proud of how far steady effort had carried him.

questions.q: What did Daniel do instead of quitting?
options: He kept practising and learned from those who were quicker.
He left the team at once.
He asked to change to another sport.
questions.explanation: 原文 'trained a little harder each week and learned from the runners who beat him' 的转述;其余与文意相反。

questions.q: How did Daniel feel by the end of the year?
options: Sorry that he had ever started.
Proud of what his steady effort had achieved.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt proud of how far steady effort had carried him'(短文后半,覆盖不同位置)。
